name: OGC Application Package schema
abstract: Schema of an OGC Application Package document (DRAFT): a formal description of a process to be dynamically deployed, made of an optional process description and a required execution unit.

sources.title: OGC API - Processes - Part 2: Deploy, Replace, Undeploy

annotatedSchema:
type: object
required:
- executionUnit
properties:
  processDescription:
    type: object
    required:
    - process
    properties:
      process:
        $ref: https://ogcincubator.github.io/bblocks-ogcapi-processes/build/annotated/api/processes/v1/schemas/process/schema.yaml
  executionUnit:
    $ref: https://geolabs.github.io/ogcapi-processes-standard-as-bblocks/build/annotated/api/processes/part2/schemas/executionUnit/schema.yaml
